artifact_observations.reasoning: Some handwritten numbers (e.g., in the bottom right grid cells) appear slightly malformed or inconsistent in stroke width, typical of AI generation struggling with small, dense handwriting, though largely legible.
The upper metal ring seems to merge slightly into the paper hole without a clear mechanical gap or shadow, suggesting a minor fusion artifact where the metal meets the paper.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a binder/ring-binder and not just loose papers.
To rigorously audit the legibility and structural correctness of the handwritten numbers and printed headers, which are prone to AI artifacts.
To verify the physical separation and connectivity of the metal rings to the binding spine, checking for melting or fusion with the paper.
To ensure the rings sit physically above the paper and the paper sheets have correct layering depth.

focus_areas: Integrity of the metal ring mechanism (fusion/melting checks)
Legibility and consistency of handwritten text/numbers
Physical plausibility of paper holes around the rings
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the metal rings and the paper holes. AI often fails to render the clean cut-out of the hole or the shadow cast by the ring onto the paper. Also, scrutinize the handwritten numbers for 'melting' or nonsensical glyphs.
